design: For each matched lexical/number quadruple, capture final residual response to the same signed Attention5 perturbation in each frame. Cross each donor final-response vector with each recipient native final residual (3x3), then apply the unchanged model final RMS, unembedding, tanh and answer-group readout. Diagonals must reproduce H588. Offdiagonals are terminal residual interventions, not natural prompts.
scope: Separates frame-dependent propagation into final residual from baseline-dependent terminal readout, conditional on this response interchange. Terminal readout includes final RMS, tanh and group aggregation. Does not uniquely assign mediation to earlier blocks.
